description: This header file declares functions and inline utilities for creating and manipulating MPSImage objects for Metal Performance Shaders integration within the ATen (PyTorch) framework, specifically geared towards Metal backend tensor conversions and image processing utilities.

methods.name: createStaticImage
methods.description: Overloaded functions to create an MPSImage from size specifications, source data, temporary images, or existing images.

methods.name: createTemporaryImage
methods.description: Creates temporary MPSImage objects for intermediate computations, given a command buffer and size or source image.

methods.name: copyImageToFloatBuffer
methods.description: Copies image data from an MPSImage into a float buffer.

methods.name: copyImageToMetalBuffer
methods.description: Copies image data from an MPSImage into a Metal buffer.

methods.name: imageFromTensor
methods.description: Converts a PyTorch tensor, assuming it is a Metal tensor, into an MPSImage object.

methods.name: computeImageSize
methods.description: Calculates the image shape for an MPSImage based on the tensor's sizes, handling tensors from 1D to 5D as per specified conventions.
